drafts.subject: Price query: invoice PPF-03539 against PO 4500012110
drafts.body:
Hi R. Delaney,

Invoice PPF-03539 from Portarlington Packaging Films Pty Ltd (total $12,441.00 inc GST) is on hold because line 1 is priced above PO 4500012110.

Line 1 (BOPP film 20um x 1000mm, 6000 m roll): billed $281.00 per roll against the PO price of $265.00. That is 6.0% higher, or $480.00 over on the line, and it exceeds our tolerance of 2% or $250.00 per line, whichever is lower.

Could you please let us know whether this higher price was agreed with the vendor?

- If yes: please amend the PO price to $281.00 (with the supporting agreement) so we can release the invoice for payment.
- If no: we will ask the vendor for a credit note for the $480.00 difference.

A reply at your earliest convenience would be appreciated so we can pay within terms.

Thanks,
Accounts Payable, Corio Packaging
